name: aether
description: Aether 协同智能介质 monorepo：Turborepo + pnpm + Next.js 16 + Vite 8

scripts.vercel-build: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@aether/web^... && pnpm --filter @aether/editor-host build && rm -rf apps/@aether/web/public/editor && mkdir -p apps/@aether/web/public/editor && cp -R apps/@aether/editor-host/dist/. apps/@aether/web/public/editor/ && pnpm --filter @aether/web build && if [ -f apps/@aether/web/.next/routes-manifest.json ] && [ ! -f apps/@aether/web/.next/routes-manifest-deterministic.json ]; then cp apps/@aether/web/.next/routes-manifest.json apps/@aether/web/.next/routes-manifest-deterministic.json; fi

packageManagerNote: 使用 pnpm 11；Node >= 22。包命名一律 @aether scope。
